End-to-end automation

Lead to delivery.
Every step, handled.

Every stage of the load lifecycle — automated, tracked, and optimized by Bella AI so nothing falls through the cracks.

01

Lead capture

Bella AI identifies and qualifies inbound load opportunities from brokers and direct clients.

02

Negotiation

AI negotiates rates automatically — floor, target, ceiling all set by you.

03

Assignment

Driver assigned based on HOS compliance, location, and load requirements.

04

In transit

Real-time tracking with proactive alerts for delays, issues, and ETA changes.

05

Delivery

POD captured, customer notified, and load closed automatically.

06

Invoicing

Invoice generated and sent with all supporting documents attached.

Why TruckDispatch Pro exists

The problems we're solving.

01

Hours lost chasing loads

Dispatchers spend most of their day on the phone — negotiating, following up, and repeating themselves. That time could be running more loads.

02

Communication scattered everywhere

Emails, WhatsApp, phone calls, texts — no single view of what's been said, promised, or missed.

03

Operations don't scale with volume

Every new load requires more headcount. Growth hits a ceiling because the work is manual, not systematic.

04

Visibility only when things go wrong

Delays, stuck loads, missed deliveries — caught too late to fix. Reactive is the default mode.
